shared_elements: schematic carved human face or figure
relief carving on a vertical stone surface
justification: Both surfaces are upright slabs bearing carved human imagery — A shows a single crudely modelled face on a small pillar, while B shows a lunette scene of standing figures beneath a winged/rayed disc above dense registers of inscribed text. The correspondence stops at 'a stele with a human depiction': B's specific composition (disc, flanking figures, adoration scene over long inscription) has no counterpart in A's isolated, radically schematic face, and the modelling conventions differ entirely.
